parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range during which data was queried. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time is displayed in UTC.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ParentStackId
parameters.description: The ID of the parent stack.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the stack. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group.\
For more information about resource groups, see the "Resource Group" section of the [What is Resource Management?](~~94475~~) topic.

parameters.name: ShowNestedStack
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return nested stacks. Valid values:

*   true
*   false (default)

> If you specify ParentStackId, you must set ShowNestedStack to true.

parameters.name: StackId
parameters.description: The stack ID. You can specify this parameter to query only the stack ID. If you want to query the detailed information about the stack, call the GetStack operation.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros list-stacks --page-size 10 --parent-stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --show-nested-stack true --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --status CREATE_COMPLETE --stack-name MyStack --tag Value=test Key=usage --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph6aiy0000 --stack-ids 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --start-time 2023-04-01T15:10:00Z --end-time 2023-04-01T15:16:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
